trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==7]
    if not pts:return out
    lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts); le=min(c for r,c in pts); ri=max(c for r,c in pts)
    cr=(lo+hi)/2; cc=(le+ri)/2
    candidates=[(r,c) for r in range(lo,hi+1) for c in range(le,ri+1) if grid[r][c]==3]
    if not candidates:return out
    r,c=min(candidates,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-lo),abs(p[0]-hi),abs(p[1]-le),abs(p[1]-ri)))
    directions=[(abs(r-lo),-1,0),(abs(r-hi),1,0),(abs(c-le),0,-1),(abs(c-ri),0,1)]
    _,dr,dc=min(directions)
    for r,c in pts:out[r][c]=0
    n=0
    while True:
        k=n+1
        if any(not(0<=r+dr*k<h and 0<=c+dc*k<w) or out[r+dr*k][c+dc*k]!=0 for r,c in pts):break
        n=k
    for r,c in pts:out[r+dr*n][c+dc*n]=7
    return out
